summary: Valley County, Idaho lookout on the Payette NF: a camp and fire finder by the 1920s, a log cabin c.1934, destroyed 1952; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Three lookout pages agree on the 1952 destruction and the c.1934 log cabin, but Forest Lookouts attributes both dates to Kresek, so they may share one origin. The climbing guide says the lookout was soon abandoned but gives no date; the story flags this disagreement and keeps the 1952 date. The 1922 photo is a single source for the shelter and Fred Gardner; it is the only named lookout found. Its rights statement was not read, so it is not added to photos; check the item page for a licence. A search snippet warned that a 1952 University of Idaho photo is of Root Knob Lookout, not this site; that record was not read and is not cited. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives no staffing history. No record corrections proposed; the record's 1952 event matches all three pages.
